description: Read the line items of one estimate option - name, description, quantity, and prices in dollars. Use it to confirm what an estimate write created. The account's own tax row (kind "tax") is system-added to an option and rides in this list - do not count it as a line somebody entered.

option_id.description: Option id (est_...) - from hcp_list_estimates or an estimate write response
